title: Catalyst — Worker Event Stream Tail
description: Loki-only forensic tail of the worker (mini/mini-2) event stream: a decoded, filterable live read of whether the fleet is working or wedged, without ssh. Distinct from the aggregate views (control-loop-live, scheduler-health, ticket-lifecycle) and from the pino-log tail (fleet-daemon-logs). The noise floor ($noise + $noisename) is the primary control — a naive tail is ~75% heartbeats/samples/ticks/reads.

list.name: node
list.label: node
list.description: Worker host filter (host_name). Default = a single node so mirrored webhook events (catalyst.github / catalyst.linear emit on BOTH minis) show once, not twice — defect #2. Widen to All (.+) for a fleet-wide tail.

list.name: noise
list.label: noise floor (action)
list.description: Suppresses the ~75% event_action noise floor (heartbeat / sampled / tick / read / autotune-gauge / parallelism-sampled). 'signal' hides them; 'all' selects a never-match sentinel so the !~ filter becomes a no-op → raw firehose. Paired with $noisename for undecomposed families (defect #1).

list.name: noisename
list.label: noise floor (name)
list.description: Second noise clause on event_name for legacy / undecomposed families that carry NO event_action — broker.daemon.heartbeat, observability.forward_lag / forward_failed (defect #1). 'all' = never-match sentinel (no-op).

list.name: minsev
list.label: min severity
list.description: Floors the tail on numeric severity_number (INFO=9, WARN=13, ERROR=17). all=1 keeps everything; warn+ hides INFO; errors shows only ERROR.

list.name: search
list.label: search
list.description: Plain-text substring filter over the event body (|= "..."). No regex / backslashes. Empty = all.

list.name: ticket
list.label: ticket
list.description: Filter to a single Linear key via | linear_key=~"..." (regex). Empty = no-op (matches all).
